Scale: the plate is about 340 px across. If it is a dinner plate of roughly 26 cm, that is about 0.076 cm per px (13 px per cm).

The pizza slice is about 200 px wide, or roughly 15 cm. It is a square-cut slice about 13 cm by 13 cm, about 1.5 cm thick, so the footprint is roughly 150 cm². That gives a volume of about 200 cm³ at 1.5 cm, but pizza is airy, so the density is about 0.5 g/cm³. That puts the slice near 100–110 g.

The pepperoni is 4 pieces, each about 4.5 cm across and about 3 g, so about 12 g in total. I will list it as its own item. That leaves the crust, cheese and sauce at about 95 g.
